correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 and α>0, the generator is symmetric Hurwitz and trace W_v=(1/2)[(L+αI)^−1]vv. A rank-one edge restoration proves that a pendant leaf strictly outranks its adjacent internal vertex, excluding all three internal vertices. A verified three-by-three Schur reduction gives the two leaf-class diagonals; their difference has everywhere-positive denominator and numerator (m−2)α²+(m²−4)α−2. Its derivative proves one positive root for m>=3 and no root for m=2. Exact root rationalization proves the m²α*→2 limit. The standalone SymPy verification passed 406 symbolic and exact-matrix assertions; finite checks corroborate, rather than prove, the universal claim.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The strong general optimal-placement result provides a site-by-site evaluation principle, but does not fix comparative scores for this graph. A stronger all-tree group-inverse theorem covers the small-α leading-order direction; it does not determine the finite-α root or high-damping reversal. The present result is not advertised as a general all-tree leaf theorem or full controllability statement.

Group-inverse maximizers are α→0 asymptotics, not a classification for α>0; neither logically dominates the new all-parameter threshold.

originality.rationale: The directly compared primary texts establish general trace-Gramian modularity (Summers–Lygeros) and all-tree zero-damping group-inverse extremal locations (Kirkland–Neumann–Shader), but neither states nor logically supplies the exact positive-damping switching threshold on this specified two-hub family. Semantic published-record searches and accessible own-ledger claim comparisons yielded no dominating or equivalent result. This is a same-model best-knowledge originality judgment, not a priority certification; equivalent unindexed specializations remain possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed or weakly indexed specialist work may already state the same shift-dependent resolvent site ranking for the two-hub tree.

General graph-resolvent centrality or specific sensor-location examples might imply the same root after non-obvious parameter reduction; the accessible primary comparisons did not show such an implication.

value.rationale: A fixed, natural tree with two heavily branched hubs and one short terminal arm exhibits a nontrivial exact relocation of its maximizing actuator class as leakage changes, despite uniform edge conductances and equal candidate actuation strength. The theorem gives all integer branch sizes, every damping regime, all tied sites at the boundary, and a sharp dimension-dependent O(m^−2) transition scale. The explicit design criterion matters for trace-Gramian/H2 input placement, not just symbolic diagonal inversion.
